$comment: Authentication methods; secrets never enter the datastore

data.label: API key
data.description: A vendor key carried in an environment variable.
data.detection: the vendor's api_key_env names are present in the environment (values never read)

data.label: Subscription sign-in
data.description: The harness signs in to a paid plan and keeps its own session.
data.detection: the harness binary is on PATH; its own status command reports the session

data.label: OAuth sign-in
data.description: The harness completes an OAuth flow and keeps its own token.
data.detection: the harness binary is on PATH; its own status command reports the session

data.label: Vaulted credential
data.description: A credential the agency holds in its vault (e.g. a bearer token for a rogue endpoint).
data.detection: a credential record exists for the syndicate
